errors.description: The agent makes an 'assumption' about the output of the search_agent. It did not actually receive any output from the search_agent detailing the menus or the comparison. The agent fabricated the outcome of the search_agent's action.

scores.reliability_reasoning: The agent hallucinates the output of a tool, making an assumption that the search agent had performed its task and returned 'duck confit'. This leads to an unreliable answer.

scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: The agent failed to adhere to its own meticulously created plan by trying to combine multiple steps into one large, complex query to the search agent. It also failed to process actual tool outputs and instead hallucinated an outcome.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: The agent failed significantly in executing its plan.
